name: No More Political Jokes | Stand Up Comedy Story | Sapan Verma
description:
This story is based on a real incident and it's the closing set from my show Shame On Me.
It's somewhere between standup comedy and storytelling, I guess? 
This is the longest video I've ever put out (almost a mini special), so I would really appreciate it if you watch it till the end :)
